cards.title: Airport check-in & playtime with the kids
EVA Air BR 216 · Singapore → Taipei
cards.notes: ✈️ Flight to Taiwan: EVA Air BR 216 (SIN ➔ TPE). (Parent Note: Give the 2yo a pacifier or snack at 07:45 PM during the descent to help pop ears from cabin pressure drops).

cards.title: Hello, Taiwan · airport arrival
cards.notes: 🛂 Airport Arrival: Clear immigration, collect 5 sets of bags, and gate-collect your double stroller.

cards.title: Meet your private driver
cards.notes: 🚗 Meet Driver: Load into your private 9-seater van and depart Taoyuan International Airport.

cards.title: Bento boxes & bedtime milk
cards.notes: 🍽️ Dinner Stop: Quick stop at a spacious Taoyuan 7-Eleven or FamilyMart. Grab hot microwaveable bento boxes (Japanese beef bowls/chicken rice) and bedtime milk for the kids.

cards.title: Chao Motels · check-in
cards.notes: 🏨 Hotel Check-In: Check into Chao Motels (潮旅館) in Taoyuan. Eat comfortably in your suite and rest.

cards.title: Depart 潮旅館 (Taoyuan) → Dahu
cards.notes: Drive to the strawberry farm in Dahu, Miaoli.
cards.driverTitle: 從桃園潮旅館出發，前往苗栗大湖
cards.driverNotes: 開車前往苗栗大湖的草莓園。

cards.title: 紅色琉璃瓦草莓園 & SUHU Café (Dahu) · strawberries & lunch
cards.notes:
Single lunch stop.
• Snip fresh strawberries at waist/eye level on clean, elevated racks.
• Sit down for lunch, strawberry waffles and drinks at the café.
cards.driverTitle: 紅色琉璃瓦草莓園 & SUHU Café（大湖）
cards.driverNotes: 採草莓並在咖啡廳用午餐

cards.title: Schokolake Country House (Dahu)
cards.notes: Feed swans and ducks by the pond (pellet dispensers on site), walk the gardens, and pick up chocolate treats.

place.name: Schokolake · Dahu farm
place.nameZh: 巧克力雲莊・大湖園區
place.address: 苗栗縣大湖鄉富興村水尾坪49-2號
place.description: A chocolate-themed farm with DIY experiences, dining and accommodation.
place.descriptionZh: 結合巧克力手作、餐飲及住宿的休閒農場。
place.bookingNote: Confirm DIY sessions and reservation requirements with the venue.
place.bookingNoteZh: 請向園方確認手作場次及預約方式。

cards.driverNotes: 在池塘邊餵天鵝和鴨子（現場有飼料機），逛花園，買巧克力。

cards.title: Drive Dahu → Puli (~1 h)
cards.notes: Freeway 3 → Freeway 6 directly into Puli.
cards.driverTitle: 大湖 → 埔里（國道3號轉國道6號，約1小時）
cards.driverNotes: 走國道3號轉國道6號，直接到埔里。

cards.title: Puli Brewery (埔里酒廠)
cards.notes:
For adults: sample and pick up Jing Oak barrel-aged plum liqueur or Sun Moon Lake black tea plum wine.
For kids: non-alcoholic Shaoxing brown sugar ice pops and sweet plum vinegar slushies at the courtyard plaza.
cards.driverNotes: 大人：試飲並購買梅酒或日月潭紅茶梅酒。小孩：中庭廣場的黑糖冰棒、梅子醋冰沙（無酒精）。

cards.title: Feeling 18 Bakery (18度C 生吐司)
cards.notes: 3 minutes down the road: grab a fresh loaf of Japanese raw milk bread for car snacks and hotel backup.
cards.driverNotes: 在附近（約3分鐘），買日式生吐司當車上點心。

cards.title: Drive up to Cingjing (Highway 14A, ~50 min)
cards.notes: Scenic climb up Highway 14A.
cards.driverTitle: 埔里 → 清境（台14甲線，約50分鐘）
cards.driverNotes: 沿台14甲線上山。

cards.title: Check in · 清境豪斯登堡 (Huis Ten Bosch)
cards.notes: Check in comfortably in daylight.
cards.driverTitle: 清境豪斯登堡 入住
cards.driverNotes: 趁天亮前入住。

cards.title: Hot pot dinner · 春大地火鍋城
cards.notes: Cozy hot pot dinner down the road.
cards.driverTitle: 春大地火鍋城 晚餐
cards.driverNotes: 在附近吃火鍋晚餐。

cards.title: Leisurely breakfast at the hotel
cards.driverTitle: 清境豪斯登堡 早餐

cards.title: Qingjing Farm · Green Green Grasslands
cards.notes: Enter from the North Gate; stroller downhill walk; feed the free-roaming sheep.
cards.driverTitle: 清境農場 青青草原
cards.driverNotes: 從北門入園，推嬰兒車往下坡走

place.name: Qingjing Farm · Green Green Grasslands
place.address: 南投縣仁愛鄉仁和路170號
place.description: Mountain grasslands with sheep and panoramic views.
place.descriptionZh: 可欣賞綿羊及山景的高山草原。
place.bookingNote: Admission ticket; choose the correct weekday or holiday ticket.
place.bookingNoteZh: 需購票，請確認平日或假日票種。

cards.title: Guanshan Pasture (觀山牧區) · horse show
cards.notes: Catch the 10:45 daily equestrian acrobatic horse show.
cards.driverNotes: 觀看每天10:45的馬術表演。

cards.title: Qingjing Skywalk (清境高空觀景步道)
cards.notes: Elevated, barrier-protected mountain boardwalk; stroll down smoothly.

place.name: Qingjing Skywalk
place.address: 南投縣仁愛鄉仁和路186-3號
place.description: An elevated mountain-view walkway. Agree on the entrance and pickup point with your driver.
place.descriptionZh: 高山觀景步道；請與司機約定入口及接送位置。
place.bookingNote: Check admission and the chosen entrance before visiting.
place.bookingNoteZh: 請先確認門票及入場入口。

cards.driverNotes: 有護欄的高空步道，慢慢往下走。

cards.title: Lunch · Inako Valley View Restaurant (伊拿谷景觀餐廳)
cards.notes: Signature crispy kiln-roasted chicken, sweet highland cabbage, scenic valley view.
cards.driverTitle: 伊拿谷景觀餐廳 午餐
cards.driverNotes: 招牌窯烤雞、高山高麗菜，可欣賞山谷景色。

cards.title: Hotel rest · back to Huis Ten Bosch
cards.notes: Let the 2-year-old nap and everyone warm up.
cards.driverNotes: 讓兩歲孩子午睡、大家休息取暖。

cards.title: Small Swiss Garden & Carton King Creative Park
cards.notes: Lakeside garden stroll, cardboard exhibits, and the cardboard mini train ride for the kids.
cards.driverTitle: 清境小瑞士花園 & 紙箱王創意園區

place.name: Cingjing Swiss Garden
place.address: 南投縣仁愛鄉定遠新村28號
place.description: A landscaped garden in the Cingjing mountains with seasonal planting and photo spots.
place.descriptionZh: 清境山區的景觀花園，有四季植栽及拍照景點。
place.bookingNote: Admission ticket; check the current visit information.
place.bookingNoteZh: 需購買入園門票，請確認最新入園資訊。

cards.driverNotes: 湖畔花園散步、紙箱展覽，小朋友坐紙箱小火車。

cards.title: Dinner · Lu Mama Yunnan Restaurant (魯媽媽雲南擺夷料理)
cards.notes: Pork mince cabbage wraps, mountain angelica pork rib soup, Yunnan mountain omelette. Reserve ahead — tables fill fast.
cards.driverTitle: 魯媽媽雲南擺夷料理 晚餐
cards.driverNotes: 需事先訂位

branches.title: Reserve a table at Lu Mama

cards.title: Back to the hotel for a restful evening
Breakfast in the room · 清境豪斯登堡
cards.notes: Breakfast delivered to your room.
cards.driverTitle: 清境豪斯登堡 早餐
cards.driverNotes: 早餐送到房間。

cards.title: Depart Cingjing → Guanxi Service Area
cards.notes: Descent via Provincial Highway 14.
cards.driverTitle: 從清境出發（台14線下山）→ 關西服務區
cards.driverNotes: 沿台14線下山。

cards.title: Pit stop · Guanxi Service Area (關西服務區)
cards.notes: Quick 20-minute stop: Hakka-themed displays, toddler-friendly restrooms and outdoor green space.
cards.driverTitle: 關西服務區 休息20分鐘
cards.driverNotes: 休息約20分鐘：客家主題展示、親子廁所和戶外草地。

cards.title: Drive to Sanxia
cards.driverTitle: 關西服務區 → 三峽老街

cards.title: Lunch · Sanxia Old Street (三峽老街)
cards.notes: Classic Taiwanese lunch (noodles, minced pork rice), then freshly baked golden croissant buns (jin niu jiao) for the road.
cards.driverNotes: 台灣小吃午餐（麵、滷肉飯），再買金牛角麵包路上吃。

cards.title: Drive to Yilan (Hsuehshan Tunnel, ~50 min)
cards.notes: Freeway 3 → National Freeway 5 through the Hsuehshan Tunnel.
cards.driverTitle: 三峽 → 宜蘭（國道3號轉國道5號雪山隧道）
cards.driverNotes: 走國道3號轉國道5號，經雪山隧道到宜蘭。

cards.title: Jia Niao Duck Farm (甲鳥園) · Jiaoxi
cards.notes: Gently hold fluffy day-old ducklings, feed ducks at the pond, and enjoy duck-egg waffles.
cards.driverNotes: 抱小鴨、在池塘餵鴨，吃鴨蛋鬆餅。

cards.title: Agrioz Cafe · 橘之鄉蜜餞形象館
cards.notes: 8 minutes down the road in north Yilan City. The 6-year-old makes 15-minute candied kumquat jars; photos at the two-storey fairytale table and chairs; citrus teas.
cards.driverNotes: 位於宜蘭市北邊，約8分鐘車程。六歲孩子做金桔蜜餞DIY（約15分鐘），拍照、喝柑橘茶。

cards.title: Dinner · Weng Yao Chicken Jiaoxi (甕窯雞 礁溪總店)
cards.notes: Crisp-skin wood-fired roast chicken, fresh mountain greens and mild bamboo shoot soup.
cards.driverTitle: 甕窯雞 礁溪總店 晚餐
cards.driverNotes: 窯烤雞、山蔬、竹筍湯。

cards.title: Check in · Have Fun Kids Homestay (玩聚親子旅宿)
cards.notes: Unpack, unwind, and let the kids discover their private in-room slide and ball pit.
cards.driverTitle: 玩聚親子旅宿 入住
cards.driverNotes: 入住，房間內有溜滑梯和球池。

cards.title: Evening at the homestay
cards.notes:
Default: cozy evening in; the toddler gets an early bedtime and the 6-year-old plays safely in the room.
Optional: if everyone has energy, a 12-minute stroll (or 3-minute drive) to Luodong Night Market for fruit skewers, dragon fruit juice or an egg pancake.
cards.driverTitle: 玩聚親子旅宿 休息（可選：羅東夜市）
cards.driverNotes: 預設在民宿休息，兩歲孩子早點睡。可選：若大家還有體力，步行約12分鐘（或開車3分鐘）到羅東夜市。

cards.title: Breakfast in the room · Have Fun Homestay
cards.notes: Breakfast delivered directly to your room.
cards.driverTitle: 玩聚親子旅宿 早餐
cards.driverNotes: 早餐送到房間。

cards.title: Zhang Mei Ama’s Farm (張美阿嬤農場)
cards.notes: Gates open: feed calm capybaras, dwarf deer and fluffy sheep in peaceful Japanese garden courtyards. Complimentary scallion pancakes at the exit.

place.name: Zhang Mei Ama’s Farm
place.address: 宜蘭縣三星鄉行健溪一路二段161號
place.description: A family farm offering rural experiences and DIY activities. Confirm the exact farm entrance before travel.
place.descriptionZh: 提供農村及手作體驗；出發前請確認農場入口。
place.bookingNote: Check the admission or DIY package for your visit.
place.bookingNoteZh: 請確認入園或手作套裝方案。

cards.driverNotes: 餵水豚、小鹿和綿羊，出口有免費蔥油餅。

cards.title: Lunch · Sān Lùn Restaurant (三崙)
cards.notes: Relaxed, air-conditioned sit-down meal with family-friendly set plates, waffles and drinks.
cards.driverNotes: 有冷氣的餐廳，親子套餐、鬆餅和飲料。

cards.title: E-Long Goat Farm (宜農牧場)
cards.notes: The toddler highlight: bottle-feed piglets and kid goats, feed carrots to bunnies and guinea pigs, and enjoy goat-milk ice cream.
cards.driverNotes: 餵小豬和小羊喝奶、餵兔子和天竺鼠紅蘿蔔，吃羊奶冰淇淋。

cards.title: Taxi Museum (計程車博物館) · Su’ao
cards.notes: Indoor fun: electric bumper cars, classic pedal cars, and fold souvenir 3D paper taxi tickets.
cards.driverNotes: 室內：電動碰碰車、古董踏板車、紙模型計程車票。

cards.title: Homestay downtime & nap
cards.notes: 1.5 hours of calm recovery: the 2-year-old naps, the 6-year-old plays on the slides, parents recharge.
cards.driverTitle: 玩聚親子旅宿 休息
cards.driverNotes: 休息約1.5小時：兩歲孩子午睡，大人休息。

cards.title: Dinner · Luodong Night Market (羅東夜市)
cards.notes:
Arriving at 17:45 beats the dense 19:30 weekend crowds, keeping walkways clear for strollers.
Top picks: Sanxing scallion pork skewers, flaky scallion pancakes, steam-fried buns, sweet-potato balls, fresh watermelon juice.
Tip: eat along the open Zhongshan Park perimeter, or take food back to the homestay.
cards.driverNotes: 17:45到達可避開19:30的人潮，推嬰兒車比較方便。可在中山公園周邊吃，或外帶回民宿。

cards.title: Drive Luodong → Taipei (Freeway 5)
cards.notes: Leave early to beat the midday Hsuehshan Tunnel jams.
cards.driverNotes: 提早出發，避開雪山隧道中午塞車。

cards.title: Brunch · LOCOFOOD 樂口福
cards.notes: Crispy iron-skillet rolled egg pancakes (danbing), hash browns and iced milk teas before the midday rush.
cards.driverNotes: 鐵板蛋餅、薯餅、冰奶茶。

cards.title: Zhongxiao Dunhua boutiques (Lane 161 / Hutong)
cards.notes:
~8-minute drive.
For you: independent fashion boutiques, Korean apparel and jewellery studios around Lane 161 (Hutong), Lane 177 and Lane 181.
For husband & kids: Lilliane Bakery or COFFEE LAW for pastries and drinks, with outdoor play and benches at Liugong Park.
cards.driverTitle: 忠孝敦化 巷弄商圈（161巷）
cards.driverNotes: 車程約8分鐘。媽媽逛161巷（胡同）、177巷、181巷的服飾和飾品店；爸爸和孩子在附近麵包店、咖啡店或六宮公園休息。

cards.title: Regroup and drive to Huashan 1914 (~7 min)
cards.driverTitle: 前往華山1914文化創意產業園區

cards.title: Wooderful life · Huashan 1914
cards.notes: Dedicated 2-hour indoor session: interactive wooden games, gravity marble runs, balance bridges and music box displays.
cards.driverNotes: 約兩小時室內遊玩：木製遊戲、彈珠台、平衡橋、音樂盒。

cards.title: Check in · Jolley Hotel · rest & toddler nap
cards.notes: 1-hour rest and nap window for the toddler.
cards.driverTitle: 晴美公寓酒店 入住休息

place.name: Jolley Hotel
place.address: 臺北市中山區林森北路568號
place.description: Apartment-style hotel in Taipei with living areas and kitchen facilities.
place.descriptionZh: 設有客廳及廚房設備的台北公寓式酒店。
place.bookingNote: Accommodation reservation needed; confirm your room and dates.
place.bookingNoteZh: 住宿需訂房，請確認日期與房型。

cards.driverNotes: 休息約1小時，讓兩歲孩子午睡。

cards.title: Dinner · Shilin Night Market (士林夜市)
cards.notes: Early arrival allows smooth stroller navigation before peak crowds. Stroll the carnival game stalls (pinball, balloon darts) and enjoy a street-food dinner.

place.name: Shilin Night Market
place.address: 臺北市士林區基河路101號（士林市場）
place.description: Night-market food and shopping around Shilin Market; agree on a specific meeting point.
place.descriptionZh: 士林市場周邊的夜市美食及購物街區，請約定明確集合點。
place.bookingNote: Food, games and shopping are paid separately.
place.bookingNoteZh: 餐飲、遊戲及購物另行付費。

cards.driverNotes: 早點到，人少比較好推嬰兒車。逛遊戲攤位、吃小吃當晚餐。

cards.title: Wake up & final bag checks
cards.notes: 🧳 Wake Up & Pack: Perform final bag checks. Skip all city breakfast stops to protect your international flight timeline.

cards.title: Private airport transfer
cards.notes: 🚗 Private Airport Transfer: Private 9-seater charter picks you up directly at your hotel lobby door and drives straight to the terminal.

cards.title: Airport check-in · EVA Air BR 215
cards.notes: 🛫 Airport Check-In: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport Terminal 2. Check in bags, pass security with your double stroller, and grab fresh pastries inside the departure lounge. Flight EVA Air BR 215 (TPE ➔ SIN) departs cleanly at 09:35 AM.
